name: mcapp-ai-starter Dev Container
postCreateCommand: mkdir -p /home/vscode/.config/vscode-dev-containers && touch /home/vscode/.config/vscode-dev-containers/first-run-notice-already-displayed || true && mkdir -p .devcontainer/.cache/npm && python -m pip install --upgrade "dspy[mcp]" && corepack enable && if [ -f package.json ]; then npm ci || true; fi && npm install -g @contextstream/mcp-server
postStartCommand: node --version || true && NVM_NODE=$(find /usr/local/share/nvm/versions/node -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 -type d | sort -V | tail -1)/bin && sudo ln -sf $NVM_NODE/npx /usr/local/bin/npx && sudo ln -sf $NVM_NODE/node /usr/local/bin/node && sudo ln -sf $NVM_NODE/npm /usr/local/bin/npm || true
